translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Ma e wach mokor kuom Turo:

content.text: Ywaguru, yaye yiedhi mag Tarshish!
Nimar Turo osekethi,
kendo oweye maonge ot kata dho wath!
Wach osechoponegi koa e piny Saipras.
Lingʼuru thi un joma odak e chula,
kendo un jo-ohala madongo man Sidon,
un ma jokwangʼ ji osemiyo umewo.
Nam maduongʼ ema cham mag Shihor ngʼado,
mwandu mokaa kowuok Nael ema osebedo girkeni mar Turo,
kendo osebedo kar ohala mar ogendini.
Ininwangʼ wichkuot, yaye Sidon,
yaye in, ma in ohinga mar nam,
nimar nam osewuoyo niya,
“Ok asewinjo rem mar muoch bende pok anywol,
ok asepidho yawuowi kata nyiri pok abedogo.”
Jo-Misri nobed gi kuyo
ka wach nochopnegi koa Turo.
Ngʼaduru udhi Tarshish denguru,
un joma odak e chula.
Bende ma e dalau maduongʼ
machon mane opongʼ gi mor kod ilo
masani koro oke e pinje man kuonde maboyo.
En ngʼa mosechano kelo masirani kuom Turo,
wuon loch, ma jo-ohala mage ogen,
ma bende jongʼiewo mage ongʼere e piny duto?
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechano tieko sunga duto mar joma nigi duongʼ
kendo obiro kuodo wi ji duto moluor ahinya e piny.
Pururu lowo manie bath aora Nael,
yaye Nyar Tarshish,
nikech koro uonge gi dho wath.
Jehova Nyasaye oserieyo bade e nam
kendo osemiyo pinyruodhi tetni,
bende osegolo chik ne Foenikia
mondo otiek gik ma gineno kuomgi.
Nowacho niya, “Ok unuchak ubed gi mor kod ilo,
yaye Nyar Sidon Mangili ma osekethi!
“Kata bed mana ni ungʼado nam ma udhi Saipras
to kuno bende ok unuyudie yweyo.”
Neuru piny jo-Babulon,
jogi makoro ikwano ka nono!
Jo-Asuria osemiyo odongʼ kar le mag thim;
kendo negigero kargi mar ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo,
ka gilworo dala bende negimuko ohingane duto
mi giweye gunda.
Denguru un yiedhi moa Tarshish,
nikech karu mochiel motegno osemuki!

content: E kindeno wich nowil gi Turo kuom higni piero abiriyo, marom kod ngima mar ruoth achiel, to giko mar higni piero abiriyogi, nobed ne Turo mana kaka wend nyako mochot mawero niya:

content.text: “Kaw thumi ilworgo dala maduongʼ,
yaye nyako ma jachode makoro wich osewilgo,
go thumino mamit, wer wende mangʼeny
mondo kanyalore to opari.”

content: To bangʼ higni piero abiriyo Jehova Nyasaye biro kecho Turo mirese. To bangʼe nodogi e tije machon mar chode kendo notim timbene machon mag chode gi pinjeruodhi duto mag piny ngima.

To koro ohala moyudo kod chudo kuom tije noket tenge ne Jehova Nyasaye; ok nokan-gi kata kungogi ne en owuon. Ohala moyudo biro dhiyone jogo matiyone Jehova Nyasaye mondo ongʼiewgo chiemo mangʼeny kod lewni mabeyo.
